instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: $70 games should have zero microtransactions.

Assassin's Creed Odyssey sold XP boosters. When a game sells a fix for its grind, the grind is the design. Star Wars Battlefront II locked Darth Vader behind a huge grind at launch. Fans revolted and EA backed down. Elden Ring sold over 25 million copies with zero microtransactions. So why do others need them? Agree?
